svg.title: Six teams coordinate through shared clinical-trial objects and visible decisions
svg.desc: A six-population clinical-trial coordination surface joins product design and research, account and partner management, data managers, genomics insights, engineering and platform, and coordination leadership to shared study, sample, partner-mapping, and decision contracts. Decision ownership and revisions remain linked; regulatory and audit readers inspect lineage; the patient remains the affected population downstream of authoring. The final band names the investment required to sustain reusable coordination while preserving partner-format heterogeneity.
